# Local changes to roxmltree 0.21.1

Upstream: [RazrFalcon/roxmltree](https://github.com/RazrFalcon/roxmltree/tree/67644e16f43c34cadc9e163163dd1aaf7ebe205e), revision `67644e16f43c34cadc9e163163dd1aaf7ebe205e`. The crates.io archive SHA-256 is `f1964b10c76125c36f8afe190065a4bf9a87bf324842c05701330bba9f1cacbb`. Upstream licences, headers, source metadata, tests and fixtures are retained. `Cargo.toml.orig` records the upstream manifest; the local package is non-publishable and is a workspace member so its regression suite runs with the renderer.

Add `Node::namespace_declarations`, returning only declarations written on that element. The parser retains a separate range of normalized namespace declarations, including redundant declarations and explicit `xmlns:xml`. The existing `attributes` and in-scope `namespaces` interfaces retain their behavior. No second XML tokenizer or attribute grammar is introduced.

The common DOM's XML selector view uses these declarations as real `xmlns` attributes. It must distinguish local attributes from inherited namespace bindings. Tests cover default declarations and undeclarations, redundant prefix declarations, explicit XML declarations, entity-normalized namespace values and the unchanged legacy views. The provider's existing unit, API, AST and DOM tests remain active. Formatting follows the workspace formatter; tokenizer changes are formatting only. Replace an existing `filter(...).next_back()` with the equivalent `rfind(...)` in `last_element_child` and its existing DOM API test to satisfy the workspace lint gate; the existing API regressions cover this lookup. Document the existing exported tokenizer-test macro so those tests can participate in the same strict lint gate.
